source_text: Ficus produxit germina sua: nondum fructus Spiritus — caritas, gaudium, pax — sed iam germina horum. Spiritus hominis figuraliter ficulnea. In ecclesia singuli credentes diversae arbores; in una anima diversae virtutes arbores sunt.
pass_a_gloss: Fig has-brought-forth shoots its: not-yet fruits of-Spirit — charity, joy, peace — but already shoots of-these. Spirit of-human figuratively fig-tree. In church individual believers diverse trees; in one soul diverse virtues trees are.
pass_b_english: [[The fig tree has put forth its shoots >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:13]]: not yet the [[fruit of the Spirit — love, joy, peace >> Bible:Galatians 5:22]], but already their shoots. The human spirit is figuratively a fig tree. In the church each believer is a different tree; in one soul the diverse virtues are trees.
